 the test staff must be qualified and carry the suitable safety category..

The generator must be out of 
 service.

Make sure PT secondary circuit are opened at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolating the relay voltage circuit for test

Obtain copy of relay setting from 
 field maintenance file and compare it with the setting on the relay.

Connect the test leads between 
 the voltage terminals ( 9 10 ). see figure 1

Connect the test leads between

Make a short connection 
 between terminals ( 3 4 ) .

Increase the volt slowly until

Keep the pick up voltage value 
 until the relay trips .

Record the voltage value & the 
 time value in the test sheet .

Return Relay and associated Equipment into 
Service

Check that the CT and PT secondary connections return to its normal position as 
before the test.
Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( 9 - 10 ).
Disconnect the test leads from the trip contact ( 1 - 2 ).

Take off the short connection from terminals ( 
3 - 4 ).

If any equipment associated with the 
 relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
 - Breaker trip coils.
 - Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 - Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay.

Protection
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the testing procedure I1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
The PJG12B relay is 
designed primarily for the detection of grounds in normally ungrounded machine 
field circuits and cause an alarm.
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, tested by eng. Shirin Hamdy & 
eng. Azza Salama , revised by quality control eng. Adel El-Nagar at EDEP Co. quality control eng. Adel El-Nagar and accepted by General Director 
eng. Mahmoud Saker, and approved by eng. Moustfa 
Alam Head Sector of Talkha Power Station.
The first update initiated by eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, tested by eng. Shirin Hamdy & 
eng. Azza Salama , at 23 April 2008 , revised by MDEP Co.quality control eng. 
Adel El-Nagar , accepted by General Director eng.Mohamed Anber, and approved by 
eng. Farouk Awad Ali Head Sector of Talkha Power Station, coordinate eng. Samir 
Abd El gleel. Head sector of quality control eng.
Mohamed Nageeb.
Safety Precautions
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
A work permit must be issued & 
 the test staff must be qualified and carry the suitable safety category..
The generator must be out of 
 service.
Tools and Equipment
Secondary injection test set.
Test plug handle.
Test leads.
Voltmeter.
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Make sure PT secondary circuit are opened at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolating the relay voltage circuit for test
Obtain copy of relay setting from 
 field maintenance file and compare it with the setting on the relay.
Testing the Relay
Connect the test leads between 
 the voltage terminals ( 9 10 ). see figure 1
Connect the test leads between 
 the trip contact ( 1 2 )
Make a short connection 
 between terminals ( 3 4 ) .
Increase the volt slowly until 
 the relay picks up and the target appears .
Keep the pick up voltage value 
 until the relay trips .
Record the voltage value & the 
 time value in the test sheet .
Return Relay and associated Equipment into 
Service
Check that the CT and PT secondary connections return to its normal position as 
before the test.
Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( 9 - 10 ).
Disconnect the test leads from the trip contact ( 1 - 2 ).
Take off the short connection from terminals ( 
3 - 4 ).
If any equipment associated with the 
 relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
 - Breaker trip coils.
 - Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 - Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay.
